question: At the qualified R13 single-record rescue, is each of the five bytes in the unique novel anchored-context tuple individually necessary for restoration when only that coordinate is replaced by the corresponding byte from the target surface's sham record?
hypothesis: All five target actual-versus-sham context coordinates differ. Each of the five single-coordinate replacement arms will remove the sole novel support tuple and return to ten classes, eight correct alias triplets, and one split, while the unmodified targeted rescue retains nine correct triplets and zero splits.

prior_evidence.observation: Exactly one final record contributed the sole novel anchored-support tuple; inserting that record into the equal-count all-sham arm exactly reproduced actual-108 class membership and restored nine correct triplets, while the all-sham arm retained ten classes, eight correct triplets, and one split.

scope_statement: This changes one R13 dimension: one coordinate of the unique rescuing five-byte context tuple. Streams, target selection, motifs, seeds, budgets, representation, induction, capacity, and evaluator-only audit remain unchanged. It makes no population, task-learning, or language-competence claim.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, CKB-plane, or cross-lane authority

arms_and_inputs.targeted_rescue108_control: Exact R13 targeted rescue with the unique actual final record.
arms_and_inputs.single_coordinate_arms: Exactly five arms in context-coordinate order [phase_anchor,prefix0,prefix1,suffix0,suffix1]. Each starts from targeted_rescue108 and replaces exactly byte offset [3,4,5,10,11], respectively, in the target final record with the same offset from that surface's sample-index-106 sham record; motif and noise bytes are unchanged.
arms_and_inputs.target_selection: Exact R13 pre-induction rule; the sole surface whose actual sample-index-107 record adds anchored support absent at budget 107.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Exact support-set deltas, class cardinality, class-membership comparison, and evaluator-only entity audit; no task model is trained.

seeds.all_arms: Exact R6-R13 independent seeds; interventions introduce no random draw.

controls: R13 budget107, all-sham, and targeted-rescue controls must reproduce before intervention output is emitted.
The complete fixed five-coordinate intervention matrix runs once in declared order.
Each arm differs from targeted rescue at exactly one declared context byte in the target final record; all five replacement bytes must differ from actual, and motif/noise bytes remain actual.
Every arm has 108 records per surface and 2916 total records.
Target selection and induction do not receive entity or family labels; labels enter only the post-induction audit.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The local deterministic R13 probe reproduces single_record_sufficiency_supported before R14 output.
Target selection yields exactly one surface and each of the five declared context-coordinate substitutions is a real one-byte change copied from the frozen sham record.
All arms have frozen cardinality, valid byte ranges, finite metrics, and exactly 36 entity pairs audited per evaluated arm.
Full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, task training, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, seed search, adaptive arm selection, or evaluator leakage occurs.

classification_rules.five_coordinate_conjunction_supported: Validity and controls pass; all five single-coordinate replacements remove novel support, exactly reproduce all-sham membership, and destabilize restoration without collision.
classification_rules.coordinate_redundancy_observed: Validity and controls pass; at least one real single-coordinate replacement preserves the targeted-rescue membership.
classification_rules.partial_coordinate_necessity: Validity and controls pass; some but not all coordinate replacements destabilize restoration.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass but none of the preceding rules applies.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Any frozen R13 control or construction threshold fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents all five fixed interventions.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, target-cardinality, construction, arm-cardinality, support-accounting, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on identity, R13 replication, target uniqueness, coordinate difference, construction, build, or frozen-package drift.
After R14 output begins, complete all five arms and frozen evaluations unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not omit coordinates, inspect alternate replacement records, or alter controls, metrics, thresholds, budgets, capacity, or classification after observing R14 output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No arm, coordinate, replacement source, budget, context distribution, sample sequence, seed, representation rule, class learner, control, metric, threshold, capacity, stop condition, or interpretation may change after primary R14 output.
